measurement_paths_note: tracked_paths: clean-tree check before a run. measurement_paths: everything that can change a measured value; used for the baseline-tag and record checks. The image records (pins.env, IMAGE.json) are checked separately against the image actually used.
measurement_code_paths_note: measurement_code_paths: the measurement implementation, i.e. every file that determines a raw row or its validation inside the container (contracts, frozen inputs, the runner and its libraries, the comparison and summary scripts, the unit tests, the dependency lockfile, the in-container step dispatcher, the image recipe). Host-side orchestration (run.sh, doctor, smoke check, identity tool), documentation, campaign records and this binding are not part of it.

commit_semantics.measurement_code_commit: the commit at which the final packaged engineering dry run validated the measurement implementation; measurement_code_paths must be byte-identical between it and baseline_commit
commit_semantics.baseline_commit: the commit of the annotated baseline tag; the scientific runs are launched from it with a clean tree, so every run.json 'commit' equals it
commit_semantics.registry_commit: csi/campaign-index.csv 'commit' = baseline_commit once the scientific run exists (the commit the campaign ran at, as for CSI-PROVER-01); before that, the dry-run commit
